proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6141 derives regional de- from Middle Indo-Aryan dēti/dēi, remodeled with imperative dēhi and the ‘take’ paradigm. The bare imperative belongs here; diyā and doubled de-de are excluded from this proposal.
